WITH cs AS (
        SELECT part_key FROM fct.score_detail
         WHERE trade_date = :d GROUP BY part_key
        HAVING coalesce(stddev_pop(part_value), 0) = 0
     ), daily AS (
        SELECT part_key, trade_date, avg(part_value) AS v
          FROM fct.score_detail
         WHERE part_key IN (SELECT part_key FROM cs)
           AND trade_date <= :d AND trade_date > :d - interval '40 days'
         GROUP BY part_key, trade_date
     )
     SELECT count(*) = 0 FROM (
        SELECT part_key FROM daily GROUP BY part_key
        HAVING coalesce(stddev_pop(v), 0) = 0) t

        SELECT m.ts_code, sum(m.vol_shares) v, d.vol_shares dv
        FROM md.stock_minute m JOIN md.stock_daily d
          ON d.ts_code = m.ts_code AND d.trade_date = (m.dt AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date
        WHERE m.period = 1 AND d.trade_date = :d
        GROUP BY m.ts_code, d.vol_shares
        LIMIT 100) t WHERE abs(v - dv)::numeric / nullif(dv,0) > 0.005
